problem: FR-5 of spec/changes/dashboards-that-feel-alive-and-draw-right-the-first-time (spdoc-17a01f1f5008) said placeholders 'shimmer where the panels will be'. The build delivered a grey shimmer (.aw-dash-skeleton), which contradicts 'the-thread-is-how-agentweave-shows-it-is-loading': every loading placeholder is the brand's thread, enforced by hub/ui/src/__tests__/loadingThread.test.tsx, which went red on master and blocked the 2.2.0 release. The operator decided on 2026-11-15 that the thread wins, keeping the panel-shaped placeholders. The code was changed at 12c13bd (DashboardsView.tsx PanelPlaceholders, dashboards.css); this document records the behaviour so the spec matches it.

requirements.rationale: Operator, 2026-11-15: the thread wins over the shimmer FR-5 of the motion change asked for. One moving thing, not four, and loading looks the same everywhere in the app.
requirements.statement: While a dashboard's queries first run, placeholders shaped like its panels (up to four) stand where the panels will be; the first carries the app's loading thread with the words 'Running its queries', the others are still, and nothing on the screen shimmers. The placeholders are gone once the run arrives, and are not shown when the run fails.

in_scope: What the Dashboards screen shows while a dashboard's queries first run
non_goals: Any other dashboard motion (FR-1 to FR-4 and FR-6 of the motion change stand as written)
Loading states on other screens, which the thread rule already covers

summary: While a dashboard's queries first run, panel-shaped placeholders stand where the panels will be, and the brand's loading thread runs in the first of them; nothing shimmers. This replaces FR-5 of 'Dashboards that feel alive and draw right the first time', which asked for a shimmer and so broke the app-wide rule that loading is shown with the thread. Already built at 12c13bd (2026-11-15).
